name: Product Categories Widget for Elementor
author: Akash Patel

sections.description:
WooCommerce Categories Widget – Elementor lets you display WooCommerce product categories inside Elementor using a simple drag-and-drop widget. Show category images, names, product counts, and responsive category grids without writing code.

Instead of manually creating category sections, simply drag the widget into your Elementor page, choose the categories you want to display, and customize the design using Elementor’s controls.

Whether you are building a fashion store, electronics shop, furniture website, grocery store, or any WooCommerce website, this widget makes it easy to highlight important product categories and help customers find products faster.

The plugin is lightweight, easy to use, and works directly inside the Elementor editor.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  • Display WooCommerce product categories anywhere in Elementor.
  • Show category images automatically.
  • Display category names and product counts.
  • Create responsive category grids.
  • Hide empty categories.
  • Select only the categories you want.
  • Style everything using Elementor controls.
  • Lightweight and beginner friendly.
  • Works with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Features

  • Display WooCommerce Categories
  • Display Category Images
  • Show Category Titles
  • Show Product Counts
  • Select Specific Categories
  • Hide Empty Categories
  • Responsive Design
  • Easy Styling Controls
  • Lightweight Performance
  • No Coding Required

Perfect For

  • Fashion stores
  • Electronics stores
  • Furniture stores
  • Grocery stores
  • Beauty stores
  • Jewellery stores
  • Sports stores
  • Book stores
  • Pet stores
  • Multi-vendor marketplaces

Common Use Cases

  • Homepage category sections
  • Featured collections
  • Shop landing pages
  • Brand pages
  • Seasonal collections
  • Product category navigation

Requirements

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • Elementor

Usage

  1. Drag the PBW Product Categories widget onto your Elementor page.
  2. Configure the following options:
    • Heading Tag: Select heading tag h1 to h6 for title.
    • Title: Add a title to display above the categories.
    • Description: Add a short description below the title.
    • Show Product Count: Show/Hide product count
    • Hide Empty Categories: Choose if you want to hide categories that doesn’t have any product assigned.
    • Order By: Sort listing by Title, Date & Menu Order.
    • Select Categories: Choose the WooCommerce categories you want to display.
  3. Style the widget using Elementor’s styling options.

License

  • This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Elementor.

  3. Download the Plugin:
    Download the plugin files and extract them.

  4. Upload to WordPress:

    • Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
    • Click Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
    • Install and activate the plugin.

  5. Use in Elementor:

    • Open any page with Elementor.
    • Search for the “PBW Product Categories” widget in the Elementor panel.
    • Drag and drop it onto your page.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes.

Can I display selected categories?

Yes.

Can I display category images?

Yes.

Can I display product counts?

Yes.

Can I hide empty categories?

Yes.

Is it responsive?

Yes.

Can I customize the design?

Yes, using Elementor style controls.

Does it work with Elementor Pro?

Yes.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads the widget when required.
